assessment.question:
### Exercise 9.5: Solve open sentences with two operations

8. 2 \times -6 = 24 \div r
assessment.expected_answer:
$$
\begin{align}
 -12 &= 24 \div r  \\
 -12 \times r &= 24 \div r \times r \\
 -12 \div -12 \times r &= 24 \div -12 \\
 r &= -2
\end{align}
$$
